home.heroDesc: Functional scenery, terrain and gaming tools created for BattleTech. Designed for the table, manufactured on demand and built for continuous use.
home.heroDescriptor: Scenery and gaming tools designed around the way BattleTech and Alpha Strike are played.
home.identityP1: WARDEN was born from years of experience around the gaming table. Not as a business opportunity, but as a response to real needs shared by players who wanted better tools to build immersive and functional battlefields.
home.identityP2: We do not design decorative objects. We design equipment for play.
home.identityP3: Every product exists for a reason: to improve gameplay, support clear battlefield layouts and help create memorable gaming experiences. Functionality, compatibility and durability always come before catalogue size or visual excess.
home.identityP4: Whether it is terrain, structures, accessories or complete battlefield solutions, every WARDEN design begins with the same question:
home.identityQuestion: Will this make the game better?
home.value1Desc: Every design starts from real gaming needs and practical battlefield use.
home.value2Desc: Robust materials and proven solutions designed for long-term use.
home.value3Desc: Developed by players, tested on the table and refined through experience.

home.designPrinciplesTitle: Three principles built into every WARDEN design

principle1.title: Designed around the game
principle1.desc: Every product begins with how BattleTech and Alpha Strike are actually played. Scale, footprint, elevation, line of sight and miniature placement are considered from the first design decision.

principle2.title: Built for real play
principle2.desc: WARDEN products are designed to be handled, transported and used game after game. Robustness, practicality and durability are built into every design from the start.

principle3.title: Designed to work together
principle3.desc: Scenery, terrain, maps and gaming tools are designed as parts of a coherent tabletop system, making it easier to build, expand and adapt your BattleTech and Alpha Strike tables over time.

home.step1Desc: Browse our catalog and add products to your Selection. No account needed.

hero.title: About WARDEN
hero.description: WARDEN develops physical precision equipment for the gaming experience in BattleTech Classic, Alpha Strike and AeroTech. Each product is born from a real need on the table: reducing mechanical friction, speeding up game phases and clarifying the state of play.
hero.description2: We don't manufacture decoration. We manufacture tools that earn their place on the table. If a product doesn't solve a concrete problem — whether speed, clarity or cognitive load — it doesn't get made.

mission.description: Eliminate mechanical and cognitive friction from tabletop wargaming through physical tools designed with technical criteria, manufactured with industrial materials, and validated across hundreds of real game sessions.

vision.description: To be the reference standard in functional accessories for sci-fi wargaming, maintaining the commitment to manufacturing quality, compatibility with official systems, and a design ethic where function determines form.

principles.title: Values
principles.description: Six principles that govern every design, material and production decision.

0.title: Functionality
0.desc: Every product serves a clear, definable purpose within the game. We don't manufacture decorative objects. A WARDEN tool is on your table because it actively improves your gaming experience.

1.title: Compatibility
1.desc: All products are designed to work with official BattleTech maps, record sheets, miniatures and rulebooks. We test against the current editions of each supported system.

2.title: Durability
2.desc: Brass, aluminium and acrylic components machined to precise tolerances. WARDEN tools are built to withstand hundreds of sessions without degradation in fit or function.

3.title: Clarity
3.desc: Information design is a core competency. Numbers, markings and indicators are designed to be legible under variable lighting conditions and at gaming-table distances.

4.title: Consistency
4.desc: Products within a WARDEN collection share materials, design language and mechanical interfaces. There is no learning curve between tools of the same ecosystem.

5.title: Honesty
5.desc: We describe our products accurately, show real specifications, and don't promise more than we deliver. Brass develops patina. Acrylic can scratch. These aren't defects: they are characteristics of the material.

systems.title: Reference systems
systems.description: WARDEN designs and tests its products for the three main systems of the BattleTech ecosystem.

philosophy.title: Design to play. Build to last.
philosophy.description: Three principles that define how we think, design and manufacture.

0.title: Design to play
0.desc: Every WARDEN product begins with a gameplay problem. If it doesn't speed up a phase, clarify a rule or reduce cognitive load, it isn't made. No decoration. No filler. Just function.

1.title: Build to last
1.desc: Brass, aluminium and acrylic machined to precise tolerances. Every material is selected for its mechanical properties and validated across hundreds of sessions. A WARDEN tool must survive the campaign.

2.title: Evolve without losing identity
2.desc: New products, new systems, new materials — but the same commitment to clarity, compatibility and consistency. Every collection adds capability without fragmenting the experience.

history.title: Trajectory
history.description: From the community to the catalog. The milestones that have defined the project.

0.title: Origin in the community
0.desc: The project begins in BattleTech communities as a response to the lack of specialised physical tools. First prototypes designed and tested among players.

1.title: Artisan stage
1.desc: Manual production in small batches. Every piece cut, assembled and individually checked. The community validates the approach: tools that solve real gameplay problems.

2.title: 3D printing
2.desc: Introduction of additive manufacturing to iterate faster. Prototypes go from weeks to days. The catalogue expands and designs are refined with direct user feedback.

3.title: Nadir Point
3.desc: First unified collection. Products stop being isolated pieces and are organised into a coherent system. The design language that defines the brand is established.

4.title: MechWarrior Online
4.desc: Collaboration with the MWO community. Exposure to a wider player base drives design improvements and confirms the demand for quality physical tools.

5.title: WARDEN Core
5.desc: Launch of the flagship collection. Definitive industrial materials: brass, aluminium and acrylic. Tightened manufacturing tolerances. The collection becomes the reference standard.

6.title: Consolidation
6.desc: WARDEN consolidates as a catalogue platform with collections, bundles, drops and a budget-based selection system. The project looks ahead to new systems and collaborations with licensed studios.

designDna.title: How we design
designDna.description: Six principles that govern every engineering and manufacturing decision.

0.title: Functionality before ornamentation
0.desc: Form follows function. Every design element has an operational reason to exist. If it doesn't improve the gaming experience, it doesn't belong in the product.

1.title: Durability
1.desc: Materials selected for their mechanical properties, not their appearance. Brass, aluminium and acrylic. Tools that withstand continuous use without compromising their precision.

2.title: Compatibility
2.desc: Every product is verified against the official systems. A WARDEN tool must integrate seamlessly with the rest of the user's gaming equipment.

3.title: Viable manufacturing
3.desc: We design to manufacture. Every piece is optimised for its production process, balancing quality, cost and availability. No impossible parts or unrealistic timelines.

4.title: Multi-purpose solutions
4.desc: A tool must be useful in as many contexts as possible without compromising its primary function. Versatility without added complexity.

5.title: Operational simplicity
5.desc: The most advanced tool is the one you use without thinking. The design must be intuitive, without lengthy instructions or unnecessary learning curves.

communitySupport.title: Community Support
communitySupport.intro: Support for associations, clubs, organizers and communities that share WARDEN's values: tabletop play, artisanal precision and a sustainable community.

what.title: A collaboration program, not an advertising channel
what.body: Community Support is not a marketing program or a lead-generation strategy. It is an initiative to strengthen the wargaming ecosystem by supporting those who already build community around the table. We collaborate with organizations and initiatives that promote organized play, accessibility and the spread of tabletop wargames, with an approach that respects players and their spaces.
